tests.name: TC-AUTH-01: valid credentials start a session and return the user without secrets (FR-AUTH-001)
sessions store only a hash of the token (SEC-002)
TC-AUTH-02, TC-SEC-08: wrong passwords and unknown emails get the same rejection (FR-AUTH-002, SEC-008)
TC-AUTH-03, TC-SEC-09: inactive accounts cannot log in (FR-AUTH-003, SEC-009)
missing or malformed credentials are rejected before any lookup
TC-SEC-01: protected endpoints require a valid session (SEC-001)
TC-AUTH-04: logout ends the session so the old token stops working (FR-AUTH-004)
expired sessions are rejected even before MongoDB removes them
deactivating a logged-in user ends their access (FR-AUTH-003)
1. inventory staff set up a category and two products, which start with zero stock
2. a sale is blocked while there is no stock
3. purchase staff add a supplier and order stock; ordering alone does not change stock
4. goods arrive in two deliveries; stock rises by exactly what was received
5. inventory staff write off a damaged adapter with a reason
6. a multi-item sale deducts exact quantities, and a retried request is not counted twice
7. a sale that fails on one line deducts nothing from any line
8. both products now show as low stock, including the one exactly at its minimum
9. the manager's reports match the stored sale and stock
TC-INV-05: 10. every stock change is traceable to its source and actor, and the history adds up to current stock
11. a deactivated product keeps its stock and history but cannot be sold or reordered
12. after logging out, the same session cannot record a sale
liveness works without a database, while readiness reports unavailable
configuration rejects missing database configuration and invalid ports
readiness checks an actual MongoDB connection
unknown routes and invalid JSON have consistent errors
TC-INV-02, TC-NFR-11: increase/decrease target the right product and persist with complete audit details
zero confirmation, exact depletion and safe-integer upper boundary are supported
TC-INV-03: insufficient stock cannot commit a negative balance or history
malformed/unsafe/fractional quantities, missing reasons and unsupported client operations are rejected
authentication/authorization reject every unauthorized role and role claims
invalid/missing/inactive products and missing inventory never create duplicate stock rows
failed audit append rolls back stock; failed stock write cannot append history
concurrent additions and competing removals do not lose updates or oversell
service works independently and composes into a caller transaction with full rollback
caller cannot catch an audit failure and commit the stock change alone
purchase/sale callers use valid source/actor references and the same atomic stock rules
TC-INV-01, TC-INV-04, TC-PROD-05, TC-BR-03: stored stock search, category/low-stock filters, clearing and invalid filters
TC-NFR-01: at least 95% of 100 sequential authenticated reads finish within two seconds locally
TC-NFR-07: 10000 products and 100000 audit records retain usable inventory reads and writes
every role reaches exactly the purchasing, sales and reporting operations the SRS matrix allows
requests without a session are rejected on every operation
representative permitted transactions succeed and change stock as expected
denied transactions with valid bodies change nothing (backend, not just hidden UI)
expired, forged and logged-out sessions cannot perform protected transactions
every defined role has an agreed permission set matching SRS §13.1
TC-SEC-03: the backend allows or rejects each permission per role (FR-AUTH-007, FR-AUTH-008, SEC-003)
guards reject unknown permission names when routes are defined
the user list is limited to roles that may view users
TC-SEC-04: client-supplied role data cannot raise permissions (SEC-004)
TC-AUTH-05: role changes apply on the next request without logging in again
TC-PROD-01, TC-PROD-03, TC-PROD-04: authorized category/product create, read, edit and persistence
all catalogue endpoints require authentication and enforce each role permission
TC-COM-01, TC-SEC-06: required fields, types, lengths, numeric boundaries and unknown fields are rejected
TC-PROD-02: normalized identifiers conflict on create/update, including inactive SKUs
invalid/missing IDs and references return 400/404 without orphan stock
TC-PROD-06: deactivation retains stock/history and used categories cannot be deleted
product and stock creation roll back together when inventory creation fails
concurrent category delete/reference creation never commits an orphan product
TC-PUR-03, TC-PUR-05, TC-PUR-06, TC-PUR-07: orders preserve exact costs and partial receipts increase only intended stock
TC-PUR-02, TC-COM-05: supplier edits/deactivation preserve purchase snapshots and allow existing ordered goods to be received
draft editing, ordering and cancellation do not change stock; received orders cannot be rewritten
purchase and receipt routes enforce every role and unauthenticated requests on the backend
TC-PUR-04, TC-PUR-08: invalid dates, quantities, prices and references reject without partial records
TC-NFR-03: concurrent creation and receipt retries persist one order/receipt and one stock change
competing receipts cannot exceed the ordered quantity
a receipt key used concurrently on different orders cannot commit two stock changes
a later audit failure rolls back earlier line stock, received quantities and all history; retry succeeds
receipt persistence failure also rolls back stock/history and purchase progress
inactive products, missing inventory and stock overflow reject receipts without changing order state

migration upgrades existing 001–003 collections without replacing application records
TC-SALE-01, TC-SALE-04, TC-SALE-05: authorized sale captures details, deducts stored stock and is retrievable

failed audit writes roll back sale records and every stock deduction

schema setup is replayable and creates the expected unique indexes
seeding requires an external password and refuses production

repeated seeding preserves stock, passwords and history rather than resetting development work

database validators reject negative, fractional and unsafe stock even for direct writes

shared models reject nonexistent references on creation and query updates
models and database reject invalid prices, thresholds and status
history requires a valid actor/source and adjustment reason
